# Slate Flosser

> Slate Flosser offers dentist-invented 3-in-1 electric and manual flossers with innovative reusable floss heads for superior oral hygiene.

Slate Flosser specializes in eco-friendly dental care products featuring patented technology like nano-hydroxyapatite and PTFE-free woven floss. The product line includes rechargeable electric flossers, travel-friendly manual options, and comprehensive accessories designed for comprehensive gum and dental care.
